title: Credentials
description: Data for the credentials template (access data document): a title page and one section per service with technical settings, ports and logins.

$schema.description: URL or path of this schema, for editor support.

metadata.description: Document metadata shown on the title page, header and footer.

client_name.description: Client name, shown on the title page and in the footer.

project_name.description: Project name, shown on the title page.

created_at.description: Creation date. Must be an object; the template prints created_at.date as given.

tags.description: Tags shown as pills on the title page.

security_level.description: Classification, e.g. strictly_confidential. Not rendered by the template.

notes.description: Internal notes. Not rendered by the template.

services.description: Services, each rendered as its own section.

name.description: Service name, used as section heading.

url.description: Service URL, rendered as a link.

description.description: What the port is used for.

password.description: Password or reference, rendered as code. Missing/null/empty displays blank; mask: true replaces a nonempty value with a fixed mask.

credential_type.description: Kind of login, e.g. web, database, ssh, api_key.

description.description: Bold label above the login, e.g. the role.

notes.description: Notes shown at the end of the service section.
